dedupe_keys.name: boavizta cloud scanner aws impact estimates

description: Cloud-scanner is Boavizta's open-source tool for estimating environmental impacts from an AWS EC2 account inventory. It combines live instance and optional block-storage use with the BoaviztAPI impact model, then reports primary-energy demand, resource depletion and global-warming potential by server, application tag or region. Inputs are AWS inventory and usage metadata; outputs are JSON or Prometheus metrics. The geographic and temporal coverage follows the queried account and time of use. Source is free under AGPL-3.0 and can run as a command-line tool, metric server or AWS Lambda. A limitation is that the own README says it only covers EC2 instances and optionally block storage, not every cloud service or the whole data centre. Running it requires access to a user's AWS account and separate BoaviztAPI service; neither is needed to review its public metadata. The tool can prepare operational-impact estimates for digital-infrastructure scenarios. It is related to broader data-centre assessment tools, but no account was accessed.
name: Boavizta Cloud-scanner AWS impact estimates
